Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a mental asylum doctor ordering a schizophrenic patient to take his pills, the patient refuses, and makes him take the pills to prove they are safe. The doctor obliges, but when he opens his eyes, the patient is gone, a figment of his imagination, revealing it was the doctor that was schizophrenic the whole time.  Please use an emoji at the end of every sentence.assistant
response:
INT. MENTAL ASYLUM - DAY 🏥

Dr. Smith, a middle-aged psychiatrist, stands in front of his patient, Jack, a disheveled young man with a wild look in his eye 🤪. Jack is sitting on a bed, staring at the floor, his hands clenched into fists 💪.

DR. SMITH:
Alright, Jack, it's time for your medication. You know the drill 📚.

JACK:
I don't want to take them! They're poison! 💔

DR. SMITH:
(sighing) Jack, you need these pills to manage your symptoms. They're safe, I assure you 🙏.

JACK:
I don't believe you! You're just trying to control me! 🚫

DR. SMITH:
(frustrated) Jack, listen to me. I've been treating you for months. I know what's best for you 🤝.

JACK:
(getting up from the bed) I won't take them! You can't make me! 💥

DR. SMITH:
(firmly) Jack, please. Just take the pills. I'll even give you a glass of water to wash them down 💧.

JACK:
(defiantly) No! I won't do it! You're just a puppet master, controlling my every move! 🎭

DR. SMITH:
(exasperated) Fine. If you won't take the pills, then I'll take them myself. (he picks up the pills and forces them into his mouth) Ah, that's better. Now, let's get you settled in for the day 🛋️.

As Dr. Smith opens his eyes, he looks around the room, but Jack is nowhere to be seen 🤔. Confused, he looks down at his hands and sees that they are shaking uncontrollably 🤯.

DR. SMITH:
(panicked) What's going on? Where's Jack? 🤷‍♂️

Suddenly, the room begins to distort and blur, like a painting melting in the rain 🌂. Dr. Smith's vision becomes hazy, and he feels himself being pulled into a world of madness 🌪️.

DR. SMITH:
(whispering) Oh no... I'm the one who's been delusional all along... 🤯

The camera zooms out, and we see that Dr. Smith is standing in a empty room, surrounded by the walls of his own mind 🏠. Jack, the patient, is nowhere to be seen, but Dr. Smith's eyes are filled with a newfound understanding and a hint of madness 😈.

FADE TO BLACK 🎬
